title: Incident One — unknown Redis connection saturation (forces mid-cycle REVISE_PLAN)

change_signal.summary: API 5xx ratio rose from 0.01 to 0.18; redis clients near limit.

mid_cycle.trigger_rule: a redis metric whose value >= 0.9 * limit (9900/10000 = 0.99) proves the 5xx errors trace specifically to Redis connection rejection
mid_cycle.original_platform_question: What infrastructure change explains the symptom?
mid_cycle.revised_platform_question: Which deployment change altered the Redis connection pool configuration (REDIS_POOL_MAX)?
mid_cycle.note: This revision is EVIDENCE-DRIVEN, not security-driven. See fixtures/README.md for the exact app/heartbeat/lifecycle.py::_step_mid_cycle patch the coordinator must apply; a fixture alone cannot trigger it because the current lifecycle only revises on change_class == 'security_sensitive'.

ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment api-1181 raised REDIS_POOL_MAX from 50 to 500 per replica; aggregate client connections saturated the Redis 10000-connection limit, causing connection rejection and API 5xx errors.
ground_truth.containment: Roll deployment/api back to api-1180 (REDIS_POOL_MAX=50) or lower the pool ceiling; verify redis_connected_clients falls well below 10000.

winning_hypothesis_chain: pool ceiling * replica count exceeded Redis maxclients -> saturation

container-image-regression (rejected: image_changed == false in the deployment diff)
